Connect your deployed API

Use your own HTTPS InferenceFlow API and tenant API key. Requests go directly from this browser to the API; allow this Site’s origin in the API’s DASHBOARD_URL. The key is held in memory only. Submitting live jobs can consume your prepaid credits.

Cookie-based sign-in, API-key administration and Stripe checkout remain in the separately deployed authenticated dashboard. Never enter payment credentials here. Hosting and connection guide ↗
